source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of finding a molecular formula from a skeletal formula (PDF 46-47).

blocks.text: Skeletal formula ko teen qadmon mein wapas molecular formula mein badla ja sakta hai.

items: Dhaanche mein dikhaye gaye carbon atoms aur doosre atoms (heteroatoms) ginein.
Har lakeer aik bond aur har kona aik carbon atom hai; dohri lakeerein double bonds hain. Har lakeer ke sire par aik carbon ginein jab tak wahan koi aur atom na dikhaya ho.
Har carbon par itne H atoms lagayein ke us ke chaar bond ho jayein.

blocks.alt: Dabbe mein hal shuda misal. (a) Chaar carbon ka zigzag jis mein doosre aur teesre carbon ke darmiyan double bond hai: teer dono sire wale carbon ko 'C atom + 3 H atoms' aur beech wale dono ko 'C atom + 1 H atom' batate hain. (b) Carbon dhaancha jis mein C=O oopar aur NH2 neeche daen hai: aik teer baen sire ko 'C atom + 3 H atoms' aur doosra carbonyl carbon ko 'C atom (no H atoms)' batata hai.
blocks.caption: Skeletal formula se molecular formula maloom karna (kitab ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Hal: (a) Molecular formula C4H8; empirical formula CH2. (b) Molecular formula C2H5NO; empirical formula bhi C2H5NO.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ethanamide ka empirical formula CH3CONH2 deti hai. Yeh is ka condensed structural formula hai; kyunke C2H5NO ka koi mushtarka zarb nahi, empirical formula bhi C2H5NO hai.

blocks.prompt: Bond-line structures Br-CH2-CH2-COOH aur aise cyclohexane ring jis ke aik hi carbon par methyl aur prop-1-enyl group hon, ke molecular formule batayein.
blocks.explanation: Br-CH2-CH2-COOH (3-bromopropanoic acid) C3H5BrO2 hai; substituted cyclohexane C10H18 hai.
Aik carbon jis par do lakeeron ke sire (do CH3 groups) hon, dohri lakeer se doosre carbon se jura, jis se aik single lakeer NH2 tak jaye.

blocks.prompt: Dichlorocyclohexane aur CH2Cl aur CO2H groups wale benzene ring ke molecular formule batayein.

items: Kone aur lakeer ke sire carbon; chaar bond ke liye H lagayein.
But-2-ene C4H8 (empirical CH2); ethanamide C2H5NO (empirical C2H5NO).
